zurngtest: Test Random Number Generators with 'PractRand'

Source: R/zurngtest-package.R
zurngtest-package.Rd

Runs the 'PractRand' statistical test suite for random number generators by Chris Doty-Humphrey https://pracrand.sourceforge.net/ from R. Bits from a generator are tested at doubling lengths, and the result reports the length at which the generator first fails. Bits can come from R's own generators, from an R function, from raw bytes or a connection, or from a C function registered by another package, which is the fast path for generator packages.
